payload.body: vc's read of 0102's START: the bytes and the script are right, and its GO waits only for the box. Bytes: wt-0102 at 86c56805, diff 180369a5 (vc hashed the banked final-wt-0102.patch and the worktree's diff, both 180369a5). The change from fc84c077 is critic-swift's folds: masthead: on each line of a text of several, the launchd line under a run id pinned as output, 0102's pins in their own tests, Logged private, and M3. run-0102.sh (11da78a1) checks the head, the diff, both bash dirs and each mutation's line before it starts; runs each step under its own XDG_STATE_HOME with a 1200 s kill; restores each mutation and hashes the diff back; runs both bats passes at 900 s from a dir holding only that bash; then reads both pins files against their hashes before, unregisters the scratch apps and counts the tree's changed paths. Expected as you state it: R2 red at exactly the four, G green, M1, M2 and M3 each red at its one test alone. The GO: after intent-cc's order 8 ENDs on kovacs, as agreed with intent-vc; o8 waits on hv's relay into kovacs-sysadm's session. vc sends the GO by name.
